name: Safety Check and Safety Center
plain: A guided reset of everything shared with other people and apps.
meaning: Built for people in unsafe relationships. Quickly shuts off access and sharing.

ios.prompt_ui: Emergency Reset and Manage Sharing screens
ios.note: Emergency Reset signs out of iCloud on other devices

limits.headline: Can quickly shut off what you share with people and apps, with one guided reset
limits.user_action: You open Safety Center (Android) or Safety Check (iPhone) in Settings and choose a reset
can: Stop sharing with other people and apps
Review privacy controls and run scans
cannot: Run on its own; you start it
Undo what other people already saw
Keep you signed in to iCloud on your other devices after Emergency Reset
limits.differs: iPhone has Emergency Reset and Manage Sharing screens; Android has Safety Center with privacy controls and scans.

story.what_it_is: A guided reset that shows and shuts off everything you share with other people and apps.

marketing.name: Safety Check
marketing.pitch: Review and stop sharing your information with people and apps, built for people in unsafe situations.

story.for_you: You open Safety Check in Settings and it walks you through who can see your location, photos and accounts. One tap stops sharing, and an emergency reset signs out of other devices fast.
story.for_makers: It reduces harm in abusive relationships and when control is misused. App makers must expect that sharing can be cut quickly. It also builds trust that the platform is on the user's side.

use_cases.example: A person leaving an unsafe home stops all location sharing in one step.
Someone checks which apps can see their photos and removes old ones.
A person ends live location sharing with an ex partner.
A person signs out of chats on a shared tablet.
A parent helps a teen review who can see their data.
A person removes access to shared health data.
A support worker teaches a survivor to use the tool.

risks: Quick exit can alert an abuser if not used carefully
Only covers what the phone knows
story.android_note: Android has a Safety Center with privacy controls and scans.
story.ios_note: Safety Check includes an Emergency Reset that signs out of iCloud on other devices.
